info.name: RAHA API v1
info.description:
RAHA Laravel API (/api/v1). Folders per module; "0. Login" first (saves `token` + `token_<role>`), requests tagged `[role]` run as that role.

Run from back/: `postman collection run postman/raha.postman_collection.json -e postman/raha.local.postman_environment.json` (whole collection) or add `-i "Z. End-to-end journey"` for the happy path. Uploads use postman/fixtures/report.pdf relative to back/.

Expects a freshly seeded DB (`php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`) and `php artisan serve`.

exec: // 1) Per-role token: a request named '... [role]' uses token_<role> when a login saved it.
if (m) { const t = pm.collectionVariables.get('token_' + m[1]); if (t) pm.variables.set('token', t); }
// 2) Stay under the auth throttle (throttle:20,1 on /auth/login, register, reset, dev ...).
if (wait > 0) { console.log('auth throttle guard: waiting ' + wait + ' ms'); setTimeout(function () {}, wait); }

item.name: 0. Login
item.description: Run first. Every login saves `token` (used by the collection-level Bearer auth) and a per-role `token_<role>`. Requests elsewhere are tagged `[role]`; the collection pre-request script swaps in `token_<role>` for that request when it exists, otherwise the current `{{token}}` is used.
